field.name: project_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_SITE_PROJECT_ID
field.query: SELECT id, name FROM #__joomleague_project ORDER BY name

field.name: projectteam_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_SITE_PROJECTTEAM_ID
field.query: SELECT pt.id, CONCAT(t.name, ' - ', p.name) AS name FROM #__joomleague_project_team AS pt INNER JOIN #__joomleague_team AS t ON t.id = pt.team_id INNER JOIN #__joomleague_project AS p ON p.id = pt.project_id ORDER BY p.name, t.name

field.name: club_id
field.label: COM_JOOMLEAGUE_SITE_CLUB_ID
field.query: SELECT id, name FROM #__joomleague_club ORDER BY name
